title: Cross-attention encoding models reveal dynamic spatiotemporal routing across human higher visual cortex
abstract: arXiv:2609.36366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how the brain parses actions and events from time-varying natural inputs is a central challenge in neuroscience. Recent work has used deep neural network (DNN) models to build stimulus-computable fMRI encoding models that predict single-voxel responses to complex natural videos. However, the majority of video-computable encoding models predict responses using simple linear mappings from model tokens, overlooking the spatiotemporal structure shared by video representations and neural responses. Recent cross-attention encoding models address this limitation for static images, enabling flexible stimulus-dependent weighting of image content across space. Here, we extend this framework to naturalistic video, using per-parcel cross-attention to dynamically route features from a self-supervised video model (V-JEPA-2) across both space and time, fitting this model to fMRI responses to short video clips. translated_title: 跨注意力编码模型揭示人类高级视觉皮层中的动态时空路由
translated_abstract: 理解大脑如何从随时间变化的自然输入中解析动作与事件是神经科学的核心挑战之一。近期研究利用深度神经网络（DNN）模型构建了可计算刺激的fMRI编码模型，用于预测单个体素对复杂自然视频的响应。然而，大多数可计算视频的编码模型仅通过对模型token的简单线性映射来预测响应，忽略了视频表征与神经响应所共享的时空结构。近期的跨注意力编码模型针对静态图像解决了这一局限，能够对图像内容进行灵活的、依赖刺激的空间加权。在此，我们将该框架扩展到自然视频，采用逐脑区的跨注意力机制，将来自自监督视频模型（V-JEPA-2）的特征在空间和时间上进行动态路由，并将该模型拟合到短視頻片段诱发的fMRI响应上。我们比较了联合时空……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将跨注意力编码模型从静态图像拓展到自然视频，通过逐脑区的跨注意力机制在空间和时间维度上动态路由自监督视频模型V-JEPA-2的特征，从而更准确地建模人类高级视觉皮层对自然视频的fMRI响应。
en_tdlr: This study extends cross-attention encoding models from static images to naturalistic video, using per-parcel cross-attention to dynamically route features from the self-supervised video model V-JEPA-2 across both space and time to better predict fMRI responses in human higher visual cortex.
